spans.text: As players progress through Middara, some Combatants might get
stronger, randomly switch up their AI, or even be replaced by entirely
different types of Combatants. The following section details the special
rules to denote this Spawning behavior.
These rules replace the Alternate Tag rules from our previous versions
of Middara. If you're using a
promotional material, all Alternate Tag Combatants now Spawn according
to the rules below. However, mechanically, they still function as described
on the back of their cards and can be used with

The higher the Loot Level a Combatant Card has, the higher the Loot
Level an Encounter must be for it to Spawn.
As an Adventure progresses, or for Adventures that start at higher Loot
Levels (In the Crawl Mode for example), Combatants get stronger. When
instructed to Spawn Combatants during an Encounter, players always
Spawn Combatants whose Loot Level listed on their cards corresponds
with the Loot Level of the current Encounter.
